summary: This directory provides a collection of utility modules focused on data encoding and decoding. It serves as a centralized location for handling various character sets and binary-to-text representations, ensuring consistent data transformation logic across the shared codebase.
responsibilities: Encoding raw data into various formats
Decoding encoded strings back into usable data
relationships: Encoding utilities transform raw data into specific formats for storage or transmission.
Decoding utilities interpret encoded formats to restore original data representations.
Character set handlers ensure accurate conversion between different encoding standards.
designDecisions: Centralized shared logic to prevent duplication of encoding algorithms.
Unit-tested implementations for encoding and decoding correctness.
Decoupled utility functions to allow independent usage across different modules.
